moves.name: intro stance
moves.instruction: Stand centred as the lights come up, then drop into a wide stance.

moves.name: wide-stance groove
moves.instruction: Stay low in the wide stance and sway side to side.

moves.name: low kicks
moves.instruction: Hop, crouch, then kick each leg out to the side while staying low.

moves.name: point and turn
moves.instruction: Rise onto one leg, extend an arm to point, then hop into a crouch.

moves.name: bent-forward steps
moves.instruction: Step side to side bent forward, then crouch with hands together.

moves.name: spin and pose
moves.instruction: Turn around and finish facing the front, arms crossed.
